_comment: Closed-trade slices of the head-v35 run and the six 2026-07-31 cost-aware off-flip arms, extracted 2026-08-07 for plan 2026-08-07-001 U2. `data/` is gitignored, so this fixture is the only way CI can hold the distribution the paired-power verdict rests on — the same reason `v35-closed-trades.json` exists. Fields are verbatim from each run's performance.json and manifest.json; `session` is the KST date of ts_opened. NOTHING HERE IS DERIVED. `param_diff` is the manifest param diff against the head with `strategy_version` excluded, recorded AS EXTRACTED — the v95 arm carries TWO entries because it flips `risk_per_trade_krw` and `ratio_atr_alpha` together, while the frozen record labels it by the first alone (KTD6: report the confound, do not drop the arm). `frozen_record` cites config/sample-margin.json's `cross_trial_arms` verbatim, including its four-decimal rounding, so a recomputation can be checked against it.
